companyDescription: World's dominant advanced-node foundry · manufactures for NVDA/AMD/AAPL/AVGO and virtually every leading-edge chip designer · Q2 2026 earnings Jul 16
priceNote: Live-prices.json cache (just refreshed, <1h old). Roughly flat today heading into Thursday's Q2 print — the real action is expected around the earnings date, not before it.
summary: TSMC reports Q2 2026 earnings Thursday, Jul 16 — Wall Street expects EPS of $3.81/ADR (up from $2.47 a year ago) on revenue of $40.04B (up from $30.07B), with gross margin guided 65.5-67.5%. Analysts have been raising targets aggressively into the print: Barclays to $625, BofA to $590, Goldman to $600, all citing AI-chip demand and TSMC's advanced-node leadership. Consensus average implies ~12% near-term upside, with the highest targets suggesting up to ~38%. This is the dominant foundry for essentially every leading-edge AI chip on the market — a genuine picks-and-shovels core holding, not a speculative bet.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Reports Thursday, Jul 16, 2026. Consensus expects EPS $3.81/ADR vs $2.47 a year ago, revenue $40.04B vs $30.07B, gross margin guided 65.5-67.5%. Capex plans toward the high end of the $52-56B 2026 range signal continued aggressive capacity investment for AI demand.

catalysts.name: 2026 Capex Guidance ($52-56B range)
catalysts.description: Company has signaled capex toward the high end of its range — a proxy for how confident management is in sustained AI-chip demand through 2026-2027. Watch for any revision at the Jul 16 print.

risks: Rich analyst-target dispersion — the highest targets ($625-630) assume very strong forward guidance; a merely in-line print without a guidance raise could disappoint given how much optimism is already priced into recent target hikes
Geopolitical/Taiwan-specific risk is structural and permanent for this name — not a new development, but always worth remembering it's not priced at zero
Extremely capital-intensive business — capex toward the high end of $52-56B means FCF conversion lags revenue growth; margin guidance (65.5-67.5%) needs to hold as the company scales advanced nodes
Currency/ADR mechanics — TSM trades as an ADR, and NTD/USD moves can affect reported results independent of underlying business performance

Earnings land 2 days before the dense Jul 27-Aug 1 FOMC/Big-Tech-earnings/PCE week — a strong TSM beat could be partially overshadowed or amplified depending on how the broader AI-capex narrative trades into that window

analystTargets.note: ~12% implied upside — 6 Buy, 1 Hold in last 3 months

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed holds at 3.50-3.75%, but Chair Warsh's hawkish Jun debut FOMC (9/18 officials projecting a 2026 hike) plus today's CPI/testimony double-header keeps mega-cap tech valuations exposed to a higher-for-longer repricing.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE accelerated to 3.4% YoY (May, highest since Oct 2023) — reinforces the hawkish setup into the Jul 28-29 FOMC, which lands 12 days after TSM's own print.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: MEDIUM. TSM's own catalyst (Jul 16 earnings) is company-specific and largely insulated from the macro calendar timing, but the stock's rich multiple (already re-rated significantly on AI optimism) makes it sensitive to any broad de-rating of AI-capex names into the dense Jul 27-Aug 1 week.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk MEDIUM — the Jul 16 earnings catalyst is well ahead of the FOMC/Big-Tech/PCE cluster, giving some breathing room, but a mega-cap name this large and this reliant on the AI-capex narrative isn't immune to a broader risk-off shock later in the month.

catalystSpot.preRunupPct: target hikes have been the main pre-earnings signal this cycle rather than price drift

postWin.note: Large-cap foundry/semiconductor earnings beats on strong AI demand have typically driven mid-single-digit pops for a stock this size — using the standard mega-cap semis pattern given TSM's own most recent comparable quarterly reactions weren't available in this research pass.

postLose.note: A guidance miss or margin disappointment for a stock with this much optimism already priced into recent target hikes would likely see a sharper-than-typical reaction — sized toward the higher end of standard mega-cap semis miss reactions given the elevated expectations bar.
